events.verdict: Hunter (ATL) brings him off-arm on James' (LAL) torso off-ball and marginal contact occurs as he releases away to retrieve the pass.
Vincent (LAL) brings his arm towards Hunter's (ATL) path and the contact off-ball is marginal.
James (LAL) brushes Young's (ATL) arm during his drive, and the contact that occurs as Young is gathering the ball is marginal.
Davis (LAL) extends forward into Daniels' (ATL) path and delivers contact during the pick.
Daniels (ATL) establishes his left foot as his pivot foot, which he maintains prior to releasing his dribble.
James (LAL) is firming up over his right leg in Young's (ATL) path, and the contact during the pick is marginal.
Okongwu (ATL) and Davis (LAL) mutually engage and immediately disengage as they pursue the rebound.  The contact is marginal.
Daniels (ATL) and James (LAL) come together at the same spot on the perimeter, and the contact as James receives the pass is marginal.
Christie (LAL) is imminently exiting the lane within three seconds.
Davis (LAL) turns to roll following the expiration of the pick and incidental contact occurs with Daniels (ATL) as he has committed to going underneath the pick.
Vincent (LAL) trips over Davis' (LAL) foot and the contact causes Vincent to go to the floor.  Young (ATL) does not initiate any contact with Vincent during his drive to the basket.
Davis (LAL) momentarily grasps Okongwu's (ATL) left arm and immediately releases him as Okongwu elevates to pursue the rebound.
James (LAL) leaves his feet to pass and his right foot returns to the floor while he is still in possession of the ball.
Christie (LAL) legally contests Young's (ATL) jump shot attempt.
Hachimura (LAL) contests the shot attempt and marginal body contact occurs with Young (ATL) after the release.
Vincent (LAL) is bracing for the contact from Young (ATL) as they come together at the same spot, and marginal contact occurs as Vincent releases away from Young.
Johnson (ATL) straddles the lane line and is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Daniels (ATL) contests the driving shot attempt and marginal contact occurs with Vincent's (LAL) arm after the release.
Reddish (LAL) jumps alongside Young's (ATL) path as he contests the driving shot attempt, and the contact is marginal.
Capela (ATL) extends his arms into Davis' (LAL) back and affects his ability to pursue the loose ball.
James (LAL) extends his arms into Hunter (ATL) and initiates contact that affects his FOM off ball.
Vincent (LAL) initiates contact with Johnson's (ATL) right arm that affects his driving shot attempt.
Daniels (ATL) cleanly deflects the ball away from James (LAL) on the perimeter.
James (LAL) cleanly blocks Daniels' (ATL) shot attempt.

Replay review of the out of bounds called on James (LAL) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Daniels (NOP) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Lakers.
Daniels (ATL) cleanly ties up Davis (LAL) and a jump ball is correctly called.
Johnson (ATL) inbounds the ball within five seconds.
James (LAL) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Hawks.
Bogdanovic (ATL) legally contests James' (LAL) jump shot attempt.
